notes.title: UPDATE #1: Full Joypad (and Joystick^^) support & much more!
notes.notes:
UPDATE / PATCH #1
Wow! What a release this has been. You Supernatural UEBER-Fans have been very supportive over the last days. Not only here on Steam but also on Reddit, Twitter, or other platforms. So, thank you. All of you! ❤️

I have been already working on the first update while I was releasing the game. 
So, without further ado – Here are the first additions & patch notes: 

MAJOR
•	FULL Joypad support: UEBERNATURAL now supports your Joypads (Xbox) and Joysticks!
•	Thule camera bug fixed (happened when restarting Level 1)
•	Global values bug fixed (saving issue in some cases)
•	Steam Achievement integration (with 2 new secret achievements to test!)

MINOR
•	Clues Screen: Auto - Jump to next level after clues have been solved
•	Interface update & fixes
•	Smaller bugfixes


All the best,

Jot
ILIKESCIFI Games
